name: Improved Cleaving Finish
prerequisites: Str 13, Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Great Cleave, Power Attack, base attack bonus +6
benefit:
You can use Cleaving Finish any number of times per round.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
Once per round when you confirm a critical hit, you can spend 5 stamina points to treat that attack as if you reduced the target to 0 or fewer hit points for the purpose of using the Cleaving Finish feat.
flavor: You can cut down many opponents in a single strike.
